description: 用 Did you …? / Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. 询问和回答上周末是否做某事。

能用 did / didn't 简短回答

diagnostic_question.question: 想问「你上周末打扫房间了吗？」，应选哪一句？
diagnostic_question.answer: Did you clean your room last weekend?

description: 用 What did you do last weekend? 谈论已经发生的周末。
